Class PreCompanyCreateEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
de.eldoria.companies.events.company.PreCompanyCreateEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
CancellableWithReason, PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.entity.Player>, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class PreCompanyCreateEvent extends org.bukkit.event.Event implements PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.entity.Player>, CancellableWithReason
A player is about to found a company.

Fired after the player confirmed and before the founding price is charged. The event may be asynchronous. Cancelling it stops the founding, nothing is charged, and the player sees the reason. It fires only on the server where the player founds the company. CompanyCreateEvent follows once the company exists.
